blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI actively protects policyholders from unfair practices.
It promotes the growth and financial soundness of the insurance industry.
It encourages healthy competition to drive better service quality.
Increasing insurance penetration across India is a major regulatory objective.

blocks.content: • Promote growth of the insurance industry.
• Ensure financial soundness of insurance companies.

items: IRDAI's core mandate includes safeguarding policyholder interests and preventing unfair trade practices.
Key competitive exam questions often focus on IRDAI's dual mandate of regulation and promoting insurance penetration.
Ensuring the financial soundness of insurance companies is a statutory objective frequently queried in exams.
